name: Sniping (improved)
body:
Source Ranged Tactics Toolbox pg. 27
Aura moderate illusion CL 10th
Slot none; Price +7,500 gp; Weight —
Description
This special ability functions as sniping, except the wielder gains a +10 competence bonus on Stealth checks to remain hidden after sniping with the weapon.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, invisibility, silence; Price 3,750 gp
